purpose: Bounded source/reopen coordinates for EKI-4 falsification pressure; never semantic truth, currentness, ordering, or authority.

entries.pressure: Temporal-validity work: stale/current facts can be embedding-near; explicit deterministic supersession and use-time validity are required.
Governed evolving memory: correctness belongs to the state trajectory, not isolated stored records.
Version-aware retrieval explicitly models version sequences, change boundaries, and version-sensitive routing.
Practitioner falsification pressure: preserve superseded history and make write-time reconciliation/version relations explicit instead of relying on vector-over-history.
Direct task-specific Google Scholar-native retrieval produced no stable stronger primary record; gap is recorded rather than fabricating provenance.
